items.title: Complete spectrum of h-fold integer sumset cardinalities for fixed h and sufficiently large set size (Original Theorem 1.4)
items.author: Isaac Rajagopal
items.source_version: Discrete Analysis 2026:2, 24 pp., published 2026-07-16; exact publisher-linked arXiv:2510.23022v3 (2026-07-15)
items.difficulty_reason: H2: 超普通博士资格考试的具体剩余义务在作者§4.3的dense/sparse多参数构造，而不在单独binomial或区间引理。必须设计并控制2h−3个坐标，精确计数S/T几何序列的normal forms及生成函数降幅，利用c^0.9、c^0.8、k^0.7三种尺度使每个δ_i≤Δ_{i−1}并保留单步δ_1=1，最后通过dense端点的生成函数恒等式匹配相邻b族，将所有可能的大基数填成整段。普通增长上下界或引用Lev定理并不能给出这些可达性/无洞义务。完整当前构造与估计均保留，保守按H2，不因论文身份或长度升级H3。

primary.label: Original Theorem 1.4: full possible sumset-size spectrum for fixed h and sufficiently large k (PDF p.3)

proof_spans.label: Complete original proof of gap-exclusion Theorem 1.3 (PDF p.5)

Complete original Section 4: Theorem 1.4 combination proof, Propositions 4.1/4.2, all current filling-set and dense/sparse generating-function/interval-overlap cores, including original Figure 3 (PDF pp.8–19)

contexts.label: Original Section 1 definitions, cardinality bounds, excluded gap theorem and native Figure 1 (PDF pp.1–3)
Original Remarks 1.5/1.8, Conjecture 1.6, h=3 supporting Theorem 1.7, roadmap, diameter definition and precisely stated Lev prerequisite (PDF pp.3–4)
Original sumset graph definition and Figure 2 with path-introduction context (PDF pp.5–6)
